title: Migrate spark/terra direct-MCP contracts to codex 0.15x (or formalize the pinned 0.146 client)
body: The direct-MCP transports (spark-direct-mcp-v1, game-direct-mcp-v1) require exactly codex-cli 0.146.0; the installed client auto-updated to 0.151.0, so those lanes and the spark volume fleet refuse at preflight unless BLIND_CODEX_BIN points at a kept 0.146.0 binary (one is now installed at ~/.adventureforge-tools/codex-0146/node_modules/.bin/codex, verified codex-cli 0.146.0). Either migrate the direct contracts to the 0.15x rollout dialect the strict lane now speaks (evidence-first: probe, capture real rows, extend profiles — see the item-lifecycle dialect and luna_v1_current profile in blind-tester/codex-pure-envelope.mjs for the pattern), or formalize the pinned client as the permanent direct-lane runtime. Also unprobed: gpt-5.6-sol (multi-agent v2) on 0.15x fails closed until someone captures one real sol rollout.
